purpose: Independent supplementary prospective shadow evaluation of whether frozen SCOPE structured reasoning adds probabilistic forecasting value over a matched control on an externally generated ForecastBench question set.
interpretation_guardrail: This is not an official ForecastBench submission because forecasts occur after the official 2026-08-30 submission window. Results must not be represented as official leaderboard performance or as contamination-free evidence equivalent to an on-time submission.

target.target_rule: Use the official LLM question set associated with the 2026-08-30 ForecastBench round. Bind by immutable repository path/blob identity after preregistration and before any question-level inspection.
target.fallback_binding_rule: If the dated path is absent, bind only to the immutable latest-llm snapshot whose cycle-level metadata establishes forecast_due_date=2026-08-30; do not inspect question text to choose a target.
target.selection: ALL mechanically eligible questions in the bound official question set; no content-based selection, cherry-picking, topic filtering, difficulty filtering, or outcome-based exclusion.
mechanical_exclusions: already resolved at shadow forecast timestamp if this can be established from target metadata without using resolution values
record that cannot be sanitized without ambiguity

information_policy.allowed_input: Only the immutable forecasting question snapshot and static metadata required to interpret the forecast target, as contained in the bound question set and sanitized identically for both arms.
information_policy.prohibited_input_rule: Any field containing realized outcomes, later updates, current forecasts, current market prices, crowd probabilities, leaderboard results, fixed effects, scoring outputs, or post-due-date information is removed before either arm receives the record.

control.description: Matched standard control using the same underlying model and sanitized input

paired_arms.matched_compute_policy: Same call structure, model routes, parser, retries, timeout and generation settings; prompt length may differ because structured reasoning is the treatment.

scoring.primary_internal_estimand: mean paired Brier advantage = mean(Brier_CONTROL - Brier_SCOPE); positive values favor SCOPE
scoring.secondary_estimand: mean log-score delta = mean(ln P_SCOPE(realized) - ln P_CONTROL(realized)); positive values favor SCOPE
additional_diagnostics: calibration/reliability where sample size supports it
accuracy only as a descriptive classification metric
scoring.official_forecastbench_metric: difficulty-adjusted Brier score / Brier Index may be reported only if computed under ForecastBench methodology with appropriate external data; it is not the primary paired causal estimand for this late shadow run.
scoring.rare_event_guardrail: Do not rely on Brier alone for low-base-rate outcomes; retain log-score and calibration diagnostics.
scoring.outcome_source: Official ForecastBench resolution data only, retrieved after forecasts are irreversibly frozen.

statistics.cluster_rule: Use immutable native event/source grouping when available without content judgment; otherwise question_id. Any dependence adjustment must be specified before seeing outcomes.
checkpoints: official round due date + 7 days: descriptive rapid-resolution checkpoint only
shadow forecast timestamp + 50 days: stability-oriented checkpoint

provenance.authoritative_preregistration_time: Git commit timestamp of the final preregistration freeze commit
question_set_binding_must_record: git blob SHA or cryptographic file hash
confirmation that no question-level inspection preceded binding

limitations_declared_ex_ante: Forecasts are late relative to the official 2026-08-30 deadline and therefore are not directly leaderboard-comparable.
The OpenRouter model alias is service-level nondeterministic and may change without a bitwise-pinned model revision.
A post-deadline run has unavoidable temporal-contamination risk even with external research disabled; this must be disclosed in every interpretation.
ForecastBench and FutureEval test overlapping but non-identical constructs; cross-benchmark results must not be pooled naively.
No single ForecastBench shadow round is sufficient evidence of general predictive superiority.
